# Write to file
    with open(TEMP_FILE, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write("Line 1\nLine 2\n")

    # Read from file
    with open(TEMP_FILE, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        content = f.read()
    print("Content:", content.strip().splitlines())

    # Clean up file
    if TEMP_FILE.exists():
        TEMP_FILE.unlink()

# JSON serialize and deserialize
    data = {"name": "app", "version": 1}
    json_str = json.dumps(data)
    print("JSON loads:", json.loads(json_str))

    # CSV parse using DictReader
    csv_raw = "id,name\n1,alpha\n2,beta"
    reader = csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(csv_raw))
    for row in reader:
        print(f"CSV row: {row['id']} -> {row['name']}")

# Path manipulation using / operator
    p = Path(".") / "subfolder" / "file.py"
    print("Path:  ", p)
    print("Name:  ", p.name)
    print("Suffix:", p.suffix)

# Find matching files with glob
    root = Path(".")
    matches = list(root.glob("*.py"))
    print(f"Top-level Python files: {len(matches)}")
